receptions_deadline_state_check.name: receptions_deadline_state_check
receptions_deadline_state_check.value: ("receptions"."state" = 'pending' AND "receptions"."confirmation_deadline" IS NOT NULL) OR ("receptions"."state" <> 'pending' AND "receptions"."confirmation_deadline" IS NULL)

resource_allocations_expiry_state_check.name: resource_allocations_expiry_state_check
resource_allocations_expiry_state_check.value: ("resource_allocations"."allocation_state" = 'held' AND "resource_allocations"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("resource_allocations"."allocation_state" <> 'held' AND "resource_allocations"."expires_at" IS NULL)

resource_restrictions_scope_check.name: resource_restrictions_scope_check
resource_restrictions_scope_check.value: ("resource_restrictions"."restriction_kind" = 'store_closed' AND "resource_restrictions"."resource_id" IS NULL) OR ("resource_restrictions"."restriction_kind" <> 'store_closed' AND "resource_restrictions"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL)

service_items_nonnegative_offsets_check.name: service_items_nonnegative_offsets_check
service_items_nonnegative_offsets_check.value:
("service_items"."prepare_minutes" IS NULL OR "service_items"."prepare_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("service_items"."cleanup_minutes" IS NULL OR "service_items"."cleanup_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("service_items"."facility_cleanup_minutes" IS NULL OR "service_items"."facility_cleanup_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("service_items"."rest_minutes" IS NULL OR "service_items"."rest_minutes" >= 0)

stores_booking_defaults_nonnegative_chec.name: stores_booking_defaults_nonnegative_check
stores_booking_defaults_nonnegative_chec.value:
("stores"."default_prepare_minutes" IS NULL OR "stores"."default_prepare_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("stores"."default_therapist_cleanup_minutes" IS NULL OR "stores"."default_therapist_cleanup_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("stores"."default_facility_cleanup_minutes" IS NULL OR "stores"."default_facility_cleanup_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("stores"."default_rest_minutes" IS NULL OR "stores"."default_rest_minutes" >= 0)
